children: South Korea's headline inflation likely rose above 3% in August, a poll shows. The median forecast from 13 economists surveyed by The Wall Street Journal is for a 3.3% on-year rise in the benchmark consumer-price index, following a 2.8% rise in July. On a monthly basis, the index likely gained 0.4% in August. Deutsche Bank analysts say that elevated cost pressures continue to pass through, while improving income conditions are adding to demand-side pressures. The central bank has flagged an August inflation pickup partly due to base effects from telecommunication fee discounts offered by local mobile carriers a year earlier. The August CPI data are due on Wednesday. (kwanwoo.jun@wsj.com)
